records.description: Rainbow Extension v1.2.39 deprecated support for dApps relying on the vulnerable eth_sign signing method and added sanitization of EIP-712 signature-request fields to mitigate common phishing attacks.
records.notes: This records a material security-hardening release, not a claim that a specific exploited Rainbow vulnerability existed.
records.title: Rainbow Extension v1.2.39 added signature-security hardening

records.description: Rainbow Extension v1.1.0 redesigned the secret-recovery-phrase import flow to mitigate the known Demonic browser-wallet vulnerability reported by Halborn.
records.notes: The official Rainbow release establishes that v1.1.0 contained the mitigation. WLR does not infer an affected-version range, exploitation, realized loss, Rainbow-specific severity, or the extension launch date from this source.
records.title: Rainbow Extension v1.1.0 added Demonic mitigation

records.description: Rainbow's official mobile-wallet repository records an external beta release in February 2019 and a v1.0.0 production release in June 2019, establishing the public mobile release lineage during 2019.
records.notes: Year precision only. Earlier 2018 beta-release commits do not clearly establish an external/public boundary; neither the 2019 external-beta commit nor the later production-release commit is treated as proof of one exact initial App Store launch day.
records.title: Rainbow Mobile released externally in 2019

records.description: Rainbow's official extension repository records a production release lineage in 2023, and Rainbow's public release-notes site independently confirms the extension's public release lineage during that year.
records.notes: Year precision only. 2022 Chrome Web Store manifest and publish-workflow preparation are not treated as launch evidence; neither the first reviewed Production version bump nor a later public release-note date is asserted as the exact initial store launch day.
records.title: Rainbow Browser Extension released in 2023
